_comment: The Cucumber support helpers, scanned at the same 19 tokens as src/ rather than the 48 the rest of test/ gets. They are production-shaped code - one named helper per thing a person does - so two helpers that nearly match are a merge to make, and the tighter net is what finds them. The step files under test/specs/steps stay on the ordinary test/ scan: a Given/When/Then registration repeats by design, and the shared mechanism IS Cucumber's own registry, the same argument that exempts the migrations. src/ is scanned alongside so a helper that reimplements production logic is flagged against the source it copied - a separate run could never see that. src/ against itself is already held at 0% by .jscpd.json, so nothing new is reported there.
